name: Himeno Yuri
source:
She’s blushes easily. She is shy and timid. She’s the type who gets pushed around by others and ends up getting the short end of the stick.

She’s a bit of a klutz who cries easily, so she’s working a part-time job in customer service to try to overcome her shyness.

Although Yuri herself isn’t aware of it, she has a bit of a  lesbian side to her.

[From [url=https://www.interheart.co.jp/pcgame/premiumbox/soft/boin/]official site[/url]]
